meta.name: writing-skills
meta.description: Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把反复要讲的做事方法整理成可复用的技能包,并在上线前验证它真能跑通
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你总在重复教 AI 同一套做法,想把它固化成可复用的技能
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep re-teaching an AI the same approach and want it saved as a reusable skill.

howto.what: Claude 会按测试驱动开发的方式写技能:先用子代理跑基线场景,看它在没有技能时失败,再写 SKILL.md,验证代理遵守后堵漏洞重构。它也会审查 description 与目录结构、精简字数。
howto.when: 当你新建技能、修改已有技能,或在部署前验证技能是否有效时触发。原文硬性要求:没有先失败的测试,就不能写技能。

say.text: 帮我新建一个技能,先跑基线压力场景再写 SKILL.md
say.note: 子代理先在无技能时失败,再写文档

say.text: 看一下我技能的 description,是不是只写了何时触发
say.note: 会检查是否误把流程写进 description

say.text: 帮我精简这个 SKILL.md,细节改成引用 --help

howto.what_en: Claude writes skills via TDD: run a baseline pressure scenario with a subagent, watch it fail, write SKILL.md, verify compliance, then refactor to close loopholes. It also reviews the description and trims length.
howto.when_en: Triggered when creating a new skill, editing an existing one, or verifying a skill works before deployment. Hard rule: no skill without a failing test first.

say_en.text: Create a new skill; run the baseline scenario first, then write SKILL.md
say_en.note: Subagent fails without the skill first

say_en.text: Check whether my skill's description only states when to trigger
say_en.note: Flags workflow summaries in the description

say_en.text: Trim this SKILL.md; move details to --help references
